title.narrative: Libya Multiple Indicator Cluster Survey (MICS) Programme

description.narrative:
The proposed Action, through the MICS, will contribute to ensuring informed evidence-based advocacy to increase essential services to children and implementation of programmes that are equitable and decrease poverty and vulnerability to contribute to Sustainable Development Goal progress. The Action will also increase national capacity to generate and use child-related Sustainable Development Goal and child deprivation indicators to inform evidence-based policy dialogue and budget decisions. 

In line with the Action Document, the proposed action¿s overall objective is to enhance the Libya¿s capacity for child rights monitoring with reliable data and analysis, as well as to ensure monitoring of child-related SDGs.

The action¿s specific objectives are to: (1) Provide up-to-date and disaggregated data on the situation of children and women in Libya to inform evidence-based policymaking and programming aimed at social inclusion; (2) Contribute to the generation of data for the SDG indicators to track progress toward internationally agreed goals and (3) Build the capacity of the Bureau of Statistics and Census (BSC) in planning, implementing, and managing household surveys
